asr.full_text: Greetings to you on behalf of Be Happy 24 Club. So let's try to figure out what Bitcoin actually is. Bitcoin is often referred to as gold of the digital age. To put it simply, it is a new monetary system. Back in the day, people exchanged seashells, then gold, and paper money. Nowadays mankind has come to use digital money and crypto currency. Now, Bitcoin is the most expensive currency in the world. It is more than eighteen thousand times more expensive than the US dollar. More than 100-million people all over the world already use bitcoins in their daily lives. You can buy anything for bitcoin, be it a cup of coffee, plane tickets or even real estate property. The bitcoin cost is constantly rising due to its limited supply and constantly growing demand. These features are a mathematical foundation of the bitcoin algorithm. Why do people and companies choose bitcoin? And why is it valuable? Let's consider the usual ways used to transfer money, like Western Union or money-gram systems. People lose from 5-30% of the amount transferred , and such companies earn from $ billion dollars to 100 billion dollars annually. With Bitcoin, when sending even as much as 100 thousand dollars from one side of the world to another, you will pay just a few dollars as a commission fee. Of course, Bitcoin features many other advantages, and we can talk about them for hours. In short, they are as follows. Almost instant transfers, complete anonymity, it is impossible to fake and print this currency. So how is Bitcoin interesting for investments? In 2009, its initial cost equaled one one thousand dollar but has lately increased to $18,037 as of December 2017 the growth is more than 18 million 37,000 times within nine years you gotta right more than 18 millionseven thousand times on May 22nd 2010 the first purchase online took place person named Laszlo but a pizza for 10,000 coins at that time it was twenty-five dollars if calculated today this is the most expensive pizza in history it costs one hundred,370,000 dollars. From August 2015 to December 2017, bitcoin cost has grown more than 27 times. Who invests in bitcoin? Bill Gates, Richard Branson, and world-known companies like Google, PayPal, eBay and others do.
